# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5275

# Review — PAN-5275
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — the row hover background (FR-4 / AC-3) never renders: `hover:bg-warning/[0.14]` compiles to no CSS under this Tailwind config, yet the docs say it is there

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5275-review-5bb7a2b5
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5275/.pan/review/agent-pan-5275-review-5bb7a2b5/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5275 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5275
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5297
- HEAD reviewed: 5bb7a2b5fd69d098766504a1e0fae9dbaa7e6150
- Base: merge-base with main 964a55414d8; prior cycle SHA: none (the manifest has no prior review evidence)

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] The jumpable row has no hover background: `hover:bg-warning/[0.14]` generates no CSS — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/flywheel/FlywheelStatusPane.tsx:170`
- Severity: `!` (explicit in-scope requirement FR-4 and acceptance criterion AC-3 unmet; shipped docs describe behavior that does not exist)
- Classification / requirement scope: specification defect (the code follows the PRD verbatim) plus a validation gap in the test that claims to cover it; `in_pr_scope`.
  - PRD FR-4: "A jumpable row shows that it is a target: `cursor: pointer`, a hover background (`hover:bg-warning/[0.14]`, the class the pre-PAN-5217 row used), and the jump icon brightens…"
  - PRD D7: "Jumpable `<li>` className: `group -mx-1 flex cursor-pointer items-baseline gap-1.5 rounded-sm px-1 hover:bg-warning/[0.14]`."
  - PRD AC-3: "`01-row-hover.png` … the first shows the hovered row background, the second the jump result."
- Trigger and changed-code connection: the dashboard uses Tailwind 3.4 (`src/dashboard/frontend/package.json`: `"tailwindcss": "^3.4.19"`). `tailwind.config.js` defines `warning.DEFAULT: 'var(--warning)'` as a bare CSS variable holding a hex value, with no `<alpha-value>` placeholder. Tailwind v3 cannot apply an opacity modifier to that color, so it emits nothing for `bg-warning/<anything>`. This PR adds `hover:bg-warning/[0.14]` as the row's hover affordance.
- Expected / observed / impact: expected a visible tinted background on hover of a jumpable row. Observed: no rule is generated, so the row background never changes. The only hover cues are the pointer cursor and the brighter jump icon (`group-hover:text-foreground` does compile). The PR body admits the background "does not render visually in either screenshot". `docs/FLYWHEEL.md` (changed in this PR) now says the row has "a pointer cursor and a hover background", which is false for the shipped build. The operator's complaint was that the row looks like a target but does not act like one, so the discoverability affordance matters here.
- Evidence: I ran the dashboard's own `tailwind.config.js` through PostCSS + Tailwind with the content `hover:bg-warning/[0.14] bg-warning/[0.08] bg-warning/10 border-warning/[0.32] bg-warning`. The output contained only `.bg-warning { background-color: var(--warning) }` and no opacity variant at all. `src/index.css` has no hand-written fallback rule for `hover\:bg-warning\/\[0\.14\]` (grep found none). Screenshot `docs/screenshots/pan-5275/01-row-hover.png` shows no row tint. WI-3 step 4 required that the hovered row's computed `backgroundColor` differ from the un-hovered value; that check cannot pass. Validation gap: test `a jumpable row is pointer-styled but not a button (ac4)` asserts only that the class string is present, so it passes while the style does nothing.
- Fix:
  1. Replace the class with one that compiles. I confirmed that `hover:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--warning)_14%,transparent)]` emits `background-color: color-mix(in srgb,var(--warning) 14%,transparent)` with this config. That matches the `color-mix` pattern `src/index.css` already uses for `.badge-bg-warning`. A named utility in `src/index.css`'s `@layer utilities` would also work.
  2. Update the ac4 assertion to the new class.
  3. Retake `01-row-hover.png` and record the computed-style check from WI-3 step 4.
  4. Spec correction: amend FR-4/D7 so they name a class that compiles under `var(--hex)` colors, instead of `hover:bg-warning/[0.14]`.
  - Alternative, if the operator prefers no background: amend FR-4, AC-3 and the `docs/FLYWHEEL.md` sentence to drop "a hover background". Either way the docs and the behavior must agree.

## Non-blocking Findings

- `~` **AC-3 evidence: screenshot 02 does not show the jump result.** `docs/screenshots/pan-5275/02-row-click-jump.png` shows the Command Deck empty state ("Select a project to open its deck") under a "Live updates are delayed — reconnecting" banner. There is no conversation, no flashed message and no visible URL. It does not show that the click reached `/conv/conv-flywheel`. Retake it in the same fix cycle. The page handler is unchanged and the component tests prove the `onNeedsYouClick('m2')` call, so I did not file this as a separate blocker.
- `~` **Pre-existing (not this PR): every `bg-warning/[…]` and `border-warning/[…]` opacity class in the dashboard is a no-op.** This includes the Needs-you container's own `bg-warning/[0.08]` (FlywheelStatusPane.tsx, line 158) and many uses in `components/orders/*`, `AwaitingMergePage.tsx` and `AutoMergeToggle.tsx`. They fail for the same Tailwind reason, so the amber tints those components intend never render. The same probably holds for the other `var(--…)` signal colors (`success`, `info`, `destructive`). This deserves its own issue: either add `<alpha-value>`-capable color definitions (for example, RGB-channel variables) or a `color-mix` plugin. It is not this author's blocker. The PR body's description of it as a "pre-existing Tailwind limitation" is accurate only for those other uses. The new hover class is this PR's.
- `?` **Selection guard edge.** `endsSelectionWithin()` checks only `anchorNode`. A drag that starts outside the row and ends inside does not fire `click` on the `<li>`: the click goes to the common ancestor, so the case cannot happen. No action is needed.
- CI: test shard 4/4's first attempt failed in `tests/e2e/issue-tree.spec.ts` ("renders a Herdr-spawned reviewer as the Review row…", "takes its rows from the pane inventory alone"). That code is unrelated to the Flywheel pane; no e2e spec references `FlywheelStatusPane` or `flywheel-needs-you`. The shard was being re-run (pending) when I wrote this.

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger
| File | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/flywheel/FlywheelStatusPane.tsx` | Reviewed. Matches PRD "After" shape, D1–D9. Blocker above on line 170. |
| `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/flywheel/__tests__/FlywheelStatusPane.test.tsx` | Reviewed. All PRD-named tests are present, and the ACT 307n5z test is extended to a jumpable row. ac4 has a validation gap (class-string only). |
| `docs/FLYWHEEL.md` | Reviewed. The wording matches WI-2, but it claims a hover background that does not render (see the blocker). |
| `changelog.d/pan-5275.md` | Reviewed. One `#### Fixed` bullet, as specified. |
| `docs/screenshots/pan-5275/01-row-hover.png` | Reviewed. Shows the brightened icon on the hovered row but no background (blocker evidence). |
| `docs/screenshots/pan-5275/02-row-click-jump.png` | Reviewed. Does not show the jump result (advisory). |
| `.pan/drafts/PAN-5275.md` | Reviewed as the requirements source. The FR-4/D7 class choice is the spec defect. |
| `.pan/specs/2026-11-14-PAN-5275-…xbrief.json` | Not applicable to runtime: plan artifact, mirrors the PRD work items. |
| `.pan/continues/PAN-5275.xbrief.json` | Not applicable to runtime: plan lifecycle state. |

### Dimensions
- **Correctness:** Met. The row `onClick` is attached only when `messageId` is set. The jump button and all three inner controls (issue button, PR link, target link) call `stopPropagation`, so one click gives exactly one action. Keyboard activation of the inner controls synthesizes a click, so the same guard covers it. The selection guard returns early only for a non-collapsed selection anchored in the row. The type import (`import type { MouseEvent } from 'react'`) is correct, and eslint is clean.
- **Security:** No new trust boundary. The `href`s are unchanged and keep `rel="noreferrer noopener"`. Clean.
- **Performance:** One closure per row in a list of about 11 items, and `getSelection()` runs only on click. Clean.
- **Requirements/UX:** FR-4 and AC-3 are unmet (blocker). Everything else is met; see below.

### Requirement / AC matrix
| Item | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FR-1 row click jumps once | Met | test `clicking the row text or the row itself jumps once per click (ac1)`; diff |
| FR-2 jump button once | Met | test ac2; `e.stopPropagation()` in button handler |
| FR-3 inner controls don't jump | Met | tests ac3 (issue, PR, target link) |
| FR-4 pointer + hover background + icon brighten | **Unmet** (background) | Tailwind probe produced no CSS; screenshot 01. Cursor and icon brightening met. |
| FR-5 non-jumpable row inert | Met | test ac5; `onClick={undefined}`, no cursor or hover class |
| FR-6 no role/tabIndex/onKeyDown; ACT 307n5z | Met | diff; test ac4 attribute checks; ACT test extended with a jumpable row |
| FR-7 drag-selection guard | Met | test ac6; `endsSelectionWithin()` |
| NFR-1 file size | Met | 375 lines, under the 1000-line ceiling |
| NFR-2 no page/contracts/server change | Met | `git diff main...HEAD` touches no `pages/`, `packages/`, server or `src/lib` file |
| AC-1 tests exist and pass | Met | focused vitest: 2 files, 63/63 pass |
| AC-2 docs + changelog + lint:docs | Partially met | `npm run lint:docs` passed; changelog present; but the doc sentence claims a non-rendering hover background |
| AC-3 screenshots show hover background and jump result | **Unmet** | 01 has no background; 02 shows no jump result |
| Non-goals (no row title/role/tabIndex/onKeyDown, no handler/contracts/server change, no Playwright spec) | Met | diff |

## Verification
- `npx vitest run src/components/flywheel/__tests__/FlywheelStatusPane.test.tsx src/pages/__tests__/FlywheelPage.test.tsx` (frontend): 2 files, 63 tests passed.
- `npx eslint FlywheelStatusPane.tsx FlywheelStatusPane.test.tsx`: clean.
- `npm run lint:docs`: passed (87 docs files, 2 changelog entries).
- Tailwind probe: PostCSS + the dashboard `tailwind.config.js` over `hover:bg-warning/[0.14]` etc. emitted no opacity variant. `hover:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--warning)_14%,transparent)]` emitted a valid rule.
- CI for exact HEAD 5bb7a2b5 (run 43631453780): `overdeck/test` verification gate passed (typecheck+lint). `lint-group (effect)` passed, which covers effect diagnostics. `build (22)`, `test-e2e`, test shards 1–3 and the lint groups passed. Test shard 4/4's first attempt failed on an unrelated `tests/e2e/issue-tree.spec.ts` case, and the re-run was pending, so the shard 4 result is unverified.
- No full test suite run, per role rules.
